detail.rationale: Each case rests on a verifiable fact and the rebuttals narrow the disagreement without resolving it. The multiple and the delivery decline are real; the storage offset is not yet large enough to prove itself. Holding preserves the option to act once Q1 deliveries resolve it.
detail.strongest_objection: The storage segment is too small to support a 58x forward multiple.

claims.limitations: Storage is still 12% of revenue; the offset is unproven.

claims.statement: A 2026 product cycle can restore volume growth without further price cuts.
claims.limitations: No product timetable was available in the synthetic snapshot.

claims.statement: Deliveries fell 6% year over year for a second consecutive quarter, so the core business is shrinking.
claims.limitations: One synthetic article is the only source for the delivery figure.

claims.statement: The storage segment is too small to support a 58x forward multiple.

rebuttals.explanation: Storage growth is 52% off a base that is still only 12% of revenue. Even at that growth rate it cannot offset a 6% decline in the larger vehicle business within the stated horizon.
A 58x multiple is only defensible if storage keeps compounding above 40%. The bear is right about the level and wrong about the trajectory; this is a sizing problem, not a rejection.
rebuttals.position_change: Trims conviction from high to moderate.
